title: DB-050(a) geometry-threading pre-mount packet: server-side derivation of authoritative 2263 lot-line segments from the accepted MapPLUTO connector by BBL - the fitted-candidate path becomes production-reachable; fail-closed, engine byte-untouched
objective: Close DB-050(a) (the T070 wave's load-bearing rider): when a max-envelope request carries NO lot_line_segments and a resolvable BBL, the ROUTE derives authoritative EPSG:2263 lot-line segments server-side from mappluto_geometry_arcgis's canonical exterior ring (recorded fixtures; display 4326 NEVER measured), in a NEW module wired at the route layer - max_envelope.py stays BYTE-UNTOUCHED (it sits at the 998-line hard modularity threshold). Requests that carry segments behave byte-identically; any derivation failure keeps today's honest lot_geometry_unsupported gap with the failure reason in detail - never a fabricated rectangle. The route stays UNMOUNTED (exposure remains the DB-045(b)/B-001 mount-seam decision).
business_reason: Both T070 reviewers proved one-action adoption is production-unreachable because the geometry-free client request can never elicit a fitted candidate; this packet makes the real engine servable for the real request BEFORE the mount, with the design direction both reviews endorsed (server-side derivation by BBL, never client-sent display geometry).
